title: describe
description: Vision descriptions written by scripts/describe.py per clip: one entry per quality segment, frames in order with timestamps and the motion label sent to the VisionModel (three frames, or one frame every ~5 s on a segment longer than 20 s). Confident accidental/setup/teardown segments are skipped (no model call). Every uncertain segment carries a verdict from the model whose label wins in the shotlog. A long segment also carries its content beats — a contiguous tiling into scene-change parts (approach / inside / exit) — and each beat becomes its own shotlog candidate. Frames are never written to disk — only their timestamps.

motion_label.description: CameraBench geometric vocabulary plus the semantic moves the vision step may name in a verdict (orbit, tracking, reveal, pov)

uncertain_reason.description: echoed from the quality segment; the reasons the geometry could not commit

semantic_motion.description: semantic camera move read from the frames; travel covers travel_forward/travel_backward, none when no semantic move applies

verdict.description: the model's adjudication of an uncertain segment; its role and motion_label win in the shotlog

confidence.description: the model's confidence in its own verdict

t_s.description: timestamp of the sampled frame inside the source clip, in seconds, in time order

beat.description: one content beat of a long segment: a contiguous part of the segment between scene changes, its own shotlog candidate

id.description: beat id inside the segment, b1..bN in time order

start_s.description: beat start inside the source clip, in seconds; equals the previous beat's end

end_s.description: beat end inside the source clip, in seconds

label.description: what this part of the take is: approach, inside, exit, enter, leave, ...

summary.description: one-line summary of the beat in at most 12 words

interest.description: how interesting this beat is on its own, 0-100

hero.description: true when this beat is a hero moment

peak_s.description: the most interesting moment of this beat, inside start_s..end_s; optional

path.description: absolute path of the analysed clip

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the describe run

model.description: vision model id that produced the descriptions

llm_cost_usd.description: sum of the per-segment costs of this run

segments.description: one entry per quality segment, in time order; described segments carry the model output, skipped ones only the reason

status.description: described = the model saw the frames; skipped = no call was made

motion_label.description: the geometric label from quality, echoed as the model input

beats.description: content beats of a long segment (> 20 s): a contiguous tiling of the segment in time order, present only when the model marked at least two scene changes; each beat becomes its own shotlog candidate

interest.description: how interesting the shot is on its own, 0-100

peak_s.description: timestamp in the source clip of the most interesting moment of the segment (the object passing through the gate, the subject at its closest); validated to lie in start_s..end_s, null when the model gave none or an invalid one

hero.description: true when the segment is a hero shot worth structuring the edit around

verdict.description: required in practice for every uncertain segment; null on confident ones

skip_reason.description: why no model call was made

summary.description: one-line summary of the segment in at most 12 words, for the contact sheet and the phone review; the full description stays for the LLM director

tags.description: short tag list (lowercase single words or two-word phrases) for filtering and the contact sheet

subject_position.description: main subject centre in normalised image coordinates (photos only; drives the Ken Burns move)

photo_flaws.description: photos only: what spoils the photo, from a fixed list (burst photos are compared by it)

sharpness.description: photos only: variance of the Laplacian on a 1000 px wide grey copy; higher is sharper, comparable within a burst

allOf.$comment: described segments carry the model output; skipped ones carry a reason

media_type.description: photo records describe one still frame as pseudo-segment p1 (0..0.04 s)
